name: Workouts
summary: The four FIT50 workout lines (A–D) plus KB and band variants. Every post names one line and lists its exercises as on the live app.
slide_pattern: cover (line letter + theme) → list (5 exercises with sets × reps) → statement (finisher) → cta
extra_voice_rules: Exercise names and reps exactly as on the live app. Never rephrase.
No injury or medical claims. No 'this will build X' or 'great for Y'.
Giant Fraunces letter on the workout-line cover slide, finisher marked in coral.
extra_checks: Every exercise in the post must exist in libraries/workouts.json for the named line.
Sets and reps in the post must equal the source values exactly.
Premium users see KB and band variants in the post; free users see the bodyweight version only.
